mapper.select:
SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, P.STATUS PROJSTATUS, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.ORGID, E.ORDERNO, E.LABELNO, E.ORDERDESC, E.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, E.SAMPLEBEGINTIME, E.PARENTORDERNO, E.ACCEPTEDDATE, H.MONITORPOINTNO, H.MONITORPOINTNAME, H.FOLDERNO, H.SAMPLEORGID, W.INDEXNAME, W.INDEX1, W.INDEX2, W.INDEX3, W.INDEX4, W.INDEX5, W.INDEX6, S.EQUIPTNAME, S.FACTORYNO, S.SPECIFICATION, S.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTSID, E.REMARK, E.SAMPLEID, R.ITEMGROUP, R.ITEMGROUPID, Y.TESTITEMSORT, Y.ORGID AS TESTCAPCITYORGID, M.MONITORTMPLGROUPID, QC.USECATEGORY, TM.TESTCLASS FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER E ON A.ORDERID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER H ON A.FOLDERID = H.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_INDEX W ON A.INDEXID = W.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON A.PROJID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT S ON S.ID = A.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_ITEM_GROUP R ON R.ORDERID = A.ORDERID AND R.TESTMETHODID = A.TESTMETHODID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_CAPACITY Y ON A.TESTMETHODID = Y.TESTMETHODID AND Y.ORGID = #{loginUser.ext$.parentorgid} LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL M ON A.MONITORTMPLID = M.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_QC_CATEGORY QC ON A.QCCATEGORYID = QC.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD TM ON A.TESTMETHODID = TM.ID ) T
AND T.RUNID IS NULL
AND (INPUTUSERID IS NULL or INPUTUSERID ='' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{inputUserId},T.INPUTUSERID) > 0) AND (INPUTUSERID IS NULL OR INPUTUSERID ='' OR INSTR( ',' || T.INPUTUSERID || ',',',' || #{inputUserId} || ',' ) > 0)
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${targetTable} TAR_ WHERE TAR_.${targetTableIdColumn} = T.${targetIdColumn}
AND TAR_.${targetFilterColumn} in ( ${targetFilterValue} )
)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK TT LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT RR ON TT.ID = RR.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM AA ON TT.TESTMETHODID = AA.TESTMETHODID AND RR.ITEMID = AA.ID WHERE TT.ORDERID = T.ORDERID GROUP BY TT.MONITORTMPLID, TT.SCHEMENAME, TT.TESTID, TT.TESTMETHODID HAVING MAX(TT.ID) = T.ID )
AND T.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.TESTCAPCITYORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
ORDER BY
T.CUPNO ASC, T.ORDERNO ASC

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.CONTAINERGROUP, A.FIXATIVE, A.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, A.CONTAINERCATEGORYID, CONCAT(LISTAGG(DISTINCT CONCAT(TESTNAME, CASE WHEN SUBCONTRACTORID IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '(分包)' END), ','), ",") AS TESTNAME FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A WHERE A.ORDERID = #{orderId} GROUP BY A.CONTAINERGROUP, A.FIXATIVE, A.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, A.CONTAINERCATEGORYID) T

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.CONTAINERGROUP, A.FIXATIVE, A.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, A.CONTAINERCATEGORYID, A.STORECONDITION, A.SAMPLEWEIGHT, CONCAT(LISTAGG(DISTINCT CONCAT(TESTNAME, CASE WHEN SUBCONTRACTORID IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '(分包)' END), ','), ',') AS TESTNAME, LISTAGG(ID, ',') AS MULTITESTID, LISTAGG(DISTINCT A.ITEMGROUP, ',') AS ITEMGROUP, A.ORDERCONTAINERNO FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT T.ID, T.TESTNAME, T.SUBCONTRACTORID, T.CONTAINERGROUP, T.FIXATIVE, T.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, T.CONTAINERCATEGORYID, T.STORECONDITION, C.SAMPLEWEIGHT, D.ITEMGROUP, E.ORDERCONTAINERNO FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK T LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_ORDER_CATEGORY C ON T.CONTAINERCATEGORYID = C.CONTAINERCATEGORYID AND T.MONITORTMPLID = C.MONITORTMPLID AND T.TESTMETHODID = C.TESTMETHODID AND C.ORGID = #{loginUser.ext$.parentorgid} LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_ITEM_GROUP D ON T.ORDERID = D.ORDERID AND T.TESTID = D.TESTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_CONTAINER E ON T.ORDERCONTAINERID = E.ID WHERE T.ORDERID = #{orderId} ) A GROUP BY A.CONTAINERGROUP, A.FIXATIVE, A.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, A.CONTAINERCATEGORYID, A.STORECONDITION, A.SAMPLEWEIGHT, A.ORDERCONTAINERNO) T

SELECT DISTINCT T.ORDERNO, T.ID, T.FOLDERID, T.ORDERID, T.PROJID, T.PARENTID, T.SCHEMENAME, T.TESTID, T.TESTNAME, T.TESTMETHODID, T.TESTMETHODBASIS, T.EQUIPTNAME, T.METHODID, T.METHODNAME, T.CONTAINERCATEGORYID, T.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, T.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, T.CONTAINERGROUP, T.QCCATEGORYID, T.QCCATEGORYCODE, T.QCNAME, T.SUBPACKAGENO, T.ANALYSISTYPE, T.EQUIPTID, T.CUPNO, T.LABELNO, T.RUNID, T.MONITORTMPLID, T.ORDERCATEGORY, T.ANALYSISUSERID, T.PARTAKEUSERID, T.ANALYSISORGID, T.ANALYSISORGNAME, T.EQUIPTACQUNO, T.STOCKID, T.STOCKBATCHNO, T.INDEXCATEGORYID, T.INPUTUSERID, T.INDEXID, T. STATUS, T.ORDERDESC, T.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, T.SAMPLEBEGINTIME, T.PARENTORDERNO, T.MONITORPOINTNAME, T.FOLDERNO FROM (SELECT A.*, B.ORDERNO, B.LABELNO, B.ORDERDESC, B.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, B.SAMPLEBEGINTIME, B.PARENTORDERNO, C.MONITORPOINTNAME, D.EQUIPTNAME, C.FOLDERNO FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER B ON A.ORDERID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER C ON A.FOLDERID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT D ON A.EQUIPTID = D.ID) T
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT TAR_ WHERE TAR_.ORDERTASKID = T.ID AND TAR_.REPORTRESULT IS NULL )

SELECT DISTINCT T.ORDERID, T.ORDERNO, T.PROJNO, T.PROJNAME, T.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, ORDERDATESTR, T.ORDERCATEGORY, T.LABELNO, T.PHFLAG, T.ACCEPTEDDATE, T.ACCEPTEDTIME, T.QCCATEGORYCODE, T.PROJECTREMIND, T.COMPLEDATE, T.ANALYSISORGID FROM (SELECT A.*, B.ORDERNO, B.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, TO_CHAR((CASE WHEN (C.SAMPLE = '1') THEN B.SAMPLEBEGINDATE ELSE B.SENDDATE END), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDERDATESTR, B.LABELNO, B.PHFLAG, S.ACCEPTEDDATE, S.ACCEPTEDTIME, C.PROJNO, C.PROJNAME, C.COMPLEDATE, (CASE WHEN C.COMPLEDATE <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)+3 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) AS PROJECTREMIND FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER B ON A.ORDERID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT C ON A.PROJID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_SAMPLE S ON B.SAMPLEID = S.ID) T
AND
AND T.RUNID IS NULL
AND T.ACCEPTEDDATE >= TO_CHAR(#{startAcceptedDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND T.ANALYSISORGID = #{loginUser.orgId}

SELECT DISTINCT T.ORDERNO, T.RELATEDQCORDERNO, T.ORIGINALORDER, T.ID, T.FOLDERID, T.ORDERID, T.CLIENTORDERNAME, T.SAMPLERECEIVERDATE, T.SAMPLERECEIVERTIME, T.SAMPLEDATE, T.SAMPLETIME, T.RELATEDORDERNO, T.PROJID, T.PARENTID, T.SCHEMENAME, T.TESTID, T.TESTNAME, T.TESTMETHODID, T.TESTMETHODBASIS, T.EQUIPTNAME, T.METHODID, T.METHODNAME, T.CONTAINERCATEGORYID, T.CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, T.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, T.CONTAINERGROUP, T.QCCATEGORYID, T.QCCATEGORYCODE, T.QCNAME, T.SUBPACKAGENO, T.ANALYSISTYPE, T.EQUIPTID, T.CUPNO, T.LABELNO, T.RUNID, T.MONITORTMPLID, T.ORDERCATEGORY, T.ANALYSISUSERID, T.PARTAKEUSERID, T.ANALYSISORGID, T.ANALYSISORGNAME, T.EQUIPTACQUNO, T.STOCKID, T.STOCKBATCHNO, T.INDEXCATEGORYID, T.INPUTUSERID, T.INDEXID, T. STATUS, T.ORDERDESC, T.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, T.SAMPLEBEGINTIME, T.ACCEPTEDDATE, T.PARENTORDERNO, T.ISCONVERT, T.ORDERTASKEQUIPTNO, ( CASE WHEN T.QCCATEGORYCODE != 'N/A' THEN T.QCNAME ELSE T.ORDERCATEGORY || '_' || T.MONITORPOINTNAME END ) AS MONITORPOINTNAME, T.PROJNO, T.ORDERCONTAINERNO, T.USECATEGORY, T.CYCLE, T.FREQUENCY FROM (SELECT A.*, B.ORDERNO, B.CLIENTORDERNAME, B.RELATEDORDERNO, B.RELATEDQCORDERNO, B.ORIGINALORDER, B.LABELNO, B.ORDERDESC, B.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, B.SAMPLEBEGINTIME, (CASE WHEN SAMPLE = '0' THEN B.SENDDATE ELSE B.SAMPLEBEGINDATE END) AS SAMPLEDATE, (CASE WHEN SAMPLE = '0' THEN B.SENDTIME ELSE B.SAMPLEBEGINTIME END) AS SAMPLETIME, B.ACCEPTEDDATE, B.PARENTORDERNO, B.ISCONVERT, B.CYCLE, B.FREQUENCY, C.MONITORPOINTNAME, D.EQUIPTNAME, D.EQUIPTID AS ORDERTASKEQUIPTNO, E.PROJNO, F.ORDERCONTAINERNO, R.ANALYSISBEGINDATE AS ANALYSISBEGINDATE, QC.USECATEGORY FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER B ON A.ORDERID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_QC_CATEGORY QC ON A.QCCATEGORYID = QC.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER C ON A.FOLDERID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT D ON A.EQUIPTID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT E ON C.PROJID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_CONTAINER F ON A.ORDERCONTAINERID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN R ON R.ID = A.RUNID ) T
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT TAR_ WHERE TAR_.ORDERTASKID = T.ID AND TAR_.REPORTRESULT IS NULL )

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT T.TESTMETHODID, T.TESTCLASS, T.TESTID, T.TESTNAME, T.METHODID, T.METHODNAME, T.METHODVERSIONID, T.TESTMETHODBASIS, T.ORDERCATEGORY, T.PROJECTREMIND, T.URGENT, T.PROJID, T.PROJNO, T.REQUIREDCOMPLETEDATE, T.ORDERDATE FROM (SELECT A.*, TM.TESTCLASS, (CASE WHEN (P.SAMPLE = '1') THEN O.SAMPLEBEGINDATE ELSE O.SENDDATE END) AS ORDERDATE, (CASE WHEN (B.BIZCATEGORYID = 'HS' AND workdays_between(S.ACCEPTEDDATE,SYSDATE) = 3) OR (B.BIZCATEGORYID = 'TS' AND workdays_between(S.ACCEPTEDDATE,SYSDATE) = 5) THEN 3 WHEN (B.BIZCATEGORYID = 'HS' AND workdays_between(S.ACCEPTEDDATE,SYSDATE) > 3) OR (B.BIZCATEGORYID = 'TS' AND workdays_between(S.ACCEPTEDDATE,SYSDATE) > 5) THEN 1 WHEN P.URGENT = '1' THEN 2 ELSE 4 END) AS URGENT, P.PROJNO, P.REQUIREDCOMPLETEDATE, (CASE WHEN (P.COMPLEDATE <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)+3) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) AS PROJECTREMIND FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER O ON A.ORDERID = O.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_SAMPLE S ON O.SAMPLEID = S.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON A.PROJID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON P.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD TM ON A.TESTMETHODID = TM.ID WHERE (P.STATUS != 'cancel' OR P.STATUS IS NULL) AND (O.TERMINATION != '1' OR O.TERMINATION IS NULL) AND A.PROJID IS NOT NULL
AND P.ORGID LIKE CONCAT(#{orgId}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER C WHERE A.ORDERID = C.ID AND C.ACCEPTEDDATE >= TO_CHAR(#{startAcceptedDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND A.SAMPLERECEIVERFLAG = '1'
) T
AND
AND (RUNID IS NULL OR RUNID = '')
AND (INPUTUSERID IS NULL or INPUTUSERID ='' OR INSTR( ',' || T.INPUTUSERID || ',',',' || #{inputUserId} || ',' ) > 0 )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_EMP A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_CERT B ON A.ID = B.EMPID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_CERT_TEST_METHOD C ON B.ID = C.CERTID WHERE A.ID = #{userid} AND (A.FILTERTEST = '1' AND C.TESTID = T.TESTMETHODID AND C.METHODID = T.METHODID AND (B.EXPIREDATE IS NULL OR B.EXPIREDATE > SYSDATE) OR A.FILTERTEST = '0' OR A.FILTERTEST IS NULL) )
GROUP BY T.ORDERCATEGORY, T.URGENT, T.TESTMETHODID, T.TESTCLASS, T.TESTID, T.TESTNAME, T.METHODID, T.METHODNAME, T.METHODVERSIONID, T.TESTMETHODBASIS, T.PROJECTREMIND, T.PROJID, T.PROJNO, T.REQUIREDCOMPLETEDATE, T.ORDERDATE ORDER BY T.ORDERCATEGORY, T.URGENT ASC ) T

SELECT PO.*, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.CREATEDBYNAME PROJCREATEDBYNAME, P.TESTORGNAME, P.ENTRUSTORGNAME, BC.BIZCATEGORYNAME FROM (SELECT T.PROJID, T.MONITORTMPLID, T.ORDERCATEGORY FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK T WHERE T.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND T.PROJID IS NOT NULL AND
AND T.STATUS = 'released'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.MONITORTMPLID = T.MONITORTMPLID AND O.ANALYSISORGID = T.ANALYSISORGID AND O.PROJID = T.PROJID AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.STATUS != 'done')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.MONITORTMPLID = T.MONITORTMPLID AND O.ANALYSISORGID = T.ANALYSISORGID AND O.PROJID = T.PROJID AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.STATUS != 'released')
GROUP BY T.PROJID, T.MONITORTMPLID, T.ORDERCATEGORY) PO LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON PO.PROJID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY BC ON P.BIZCATEGORYID = BC.ID
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_REPORT R WHERE PO.MONITORTMPLID = R.MONITORTMPLID AND PO.PROJID = R.PROJID AND R.STATUS = 'draft')
ORDER BY
PO.PROJID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK T WHERE T.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.MONITORTMPLID = T.MONITORTMPLID AND O.ANALYSISORGID = T.ANALYSISORGID AND O.PROJID = T.PROJID AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.STATUS != 'released')
ORDER BY
T.PROJID DESC

SELECT A.ANALYSISDATE, COUNT(*) AS TESTCOUNT FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A
GROUP BY A.ANALYSISDATE ORDER BY
A.ANALYSISDATE ASC

SELECT A.ANALYSISUSERID, COUNT(*) AS TESTCOUNT FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A
GROUP BY A.ANALYSISUSERID ORDER BY
A.ANALYSISUSERID ASC

SELECT T.TESTID, T.TESTNAME, T.ORDERNO, T.ORDERDESC, T.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, T.SAMPLEBEGINTIME FROM (SELECT A.*, Q.ORDERNO, Q.ORDERDESC, Q.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, Q.SAMPLEBEGINTIME FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON A.PROJID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER Q ON A.ORDERID = Q.ID WHERE (P.STATUS != 'cancel' OR P.STATUS IS NULL)) T
AND
AND (RUNID IS NULL OR RUNID = '')
ORDER BY
T.ORDERCATEGORY DESC

SELECT DISTINCT T.TESTID, T.TESTNAME, T.METHODNAME, T.TESTMETHODBASIS, T.SCHEMENAME, T.ASSIGNDATE, T.ANALYSISTYPE FROM (SELECT A.* FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A) T
AND
ORDER BY
T.TESTID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK T
AND
AND (SUBCONTRACTORID IS NULL OR SAMPLINGSUBPACKAGE = '1')
ORDER BY
T.TESTID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT LISTAGG(A.ID, ',') AS IDS, A.TESTMETHODID, A.TESTID, A.TESTNAME, A.METHODID, A.METHODNAME, P.PROJNO, COUNT(A.ID) AS NUM FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON A.PROJID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER O ON A.ORDERID = O.ID WHERE ( P. STATUS IS NULL OR P. STATUS != 'cancel' ) AND A.ANALYSISTYPE = 'sampling' AND O.SAMPLEID = #{sampleId} GROUP BY A.TESTMETHODID, A.TESTID, A.TESTNAME, A.METHODID, A.METHODNAME, P.PROJNO ) T
ORDER BY
T.TESTMETHODID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, P.STATUS PROJSTATUS, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.ORGID, E.ORDERNO, E.LABELNO, E.ORDERDESC, E.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, E.SAMPLEBEGINTIME, E.PARENTORDERNO, E.ACCEPTEDDATE, H.MONITORPOINTNAME, H.FOLDERNO, H.SAMPLEORGID, W.INDEXNAME, W.INDEX1, W.INDEX2, W.INDEX3, W.INDEX4, W.INDEX5, W.INDEX6, S.EQUIPTNAME, S.FACTORYNO, S.SPECIFICATION, S.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTSID, E.REMARK, E.SAMPLEID, Y.TESTITEMSORT, Y.ORGID AS TESTCAPCITYORGID, M.MONITORTMPLGROUPID, QC.USECATEGORY, TM.TESTCLASS FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER E ON A.ORDERID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER H ON A.FOLDERID = H.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_INDEX W ON A.INDEXID = W.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON A.PROJID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT S ON S.ID = A.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_CAPACITY Y ON A.TESTMETHODID = Y.TESTMETHODID AND Y.ORGID = #{loginUser.ext$.parentorgid} LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD TM ON A.TESTMETHODID = TM.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL M ON A.MONITORTMPLID = M.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_QC_CATEGORY QC ON A.QCCATEGORYID = QC.ID ) T
AND T.RUNID IS NULL
AND (INPUTUSERID IS NULL or INPUTUSERID ='' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{inputUserId},T.INPUTUSERID) > 0) AND (INPUTUSERID IS NULL OR INPUTUSERID ='' OR INSTR( ',' || T.INPUTUSERID || ',',',' || #{inputUserId} || ',' ) > 0)
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${targetTable} TAR_ WHERE TAR_.${targetTableIdColumn} = T.${targetIdColumn}
AND TAR_.${targetFilterColumn} in ( ${targetFilterValue} )
)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK TT LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT RR ON TT.ID = RR.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM AA ON TT.TESTMETHODID = AA.TESTMETHODID AND RR.ITEMID = AA.ID WHERE TT.ORDERID = T.ORDERID GROUP BY TT.MONITORTMPLID, TT.SCHEMENAME, TT.TESTID, TT.TESTMETHODID HAVING MAX(TT.ID) = T.ID )
AND T.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.TESTCAPCITYORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
ORDER BY
T.CUPNO ASC, T.ORDERNO ASC
